spanish: Y dijo Jehová a Moisés: Extiende tu mano sobre los cielos, y sea oscuridad sobre tierra de Egipto, y palpe oscuridad.

findings.issue: Hiphil imperfect 3ms plus agreeing חֹשֶׁךְ leaves the stem causative and the noun’s role open (VSO subject of “cause to feel,” or an unnamed 3ms with darkness as what is felt). palpe is simple “feel/grope,” and oscuridad is fixed as the object of that unnamed subject.

notes: The speech frame through tierra de Egipto matches the tokens, including both instances of חֹשֶׁךְ.
